mostWorthwhile.text: Testing Asha's unfinished request and correction was most worthwhile: it showed the status mapping and two-way exchange working in practice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the port and then the gateway felt somewhat procedural, although both had a clear role in the setup.

surprise.text: Tin Row's CLOSED meant RECEIVED rather than a completed request; that small vocabulary difference could have hidden unfinished work.

arbitrary.text: The sign combination initially felt a little unclear: I knew it would mark the passage, but not what its reversible function would do.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the tested exchange and the concrete wicket repair made me curious how the two cooperatives will work together next.
